text:
Type: geometric lattice area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, contemporary, bohemian
Materials: flat-woven synthetic fibers, low pile
Colors: warm terracotta beige, cream
Shape: rectangular, interlocking hexagon and square lattice, tribal triangle bands at the ends, flat flat-woven texture, thin and light, medium-large
Feel: warm, graphic, earthy
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets; modern or bohemian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Lattice-Patterned Rug, 5' x 8', Beige and Cream
product.description: A beige and cream geometric pattern creates a rug that is textured enough to create an accent anywhere it is placed but subtle enough to work with almost any room’s color scheme. The soft pile adds a warm and stylish cushioning to your bare floors. 5'W x 8'L Front: 91% cotton, 8% polyester, 1% viscose; backing: 100% cotton Modern geometric design in classic neutrals The medium pile makes this rug ideal for moderate traffic areas. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
